name: ImageCompare
label: Image compare
description: Before-and-after image comparison with a draggable divider, keyboard control, and corner labels.

props.name: beforeSrc
props.description: Source of the image revealed on the left of the divider

props.name: afterSrc
props.description: Source of the image revealed on the right of the divider

props.name: beforeAlt
props.description: Alt text for the before image

props.name: afterAlt
props.description: Alt text for the after image

props.name: beforeLabel
props.description: Corner label over the before side

props.name: afterLabel
props.description: Corner label over the after side

props.name: handleLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the divider handle. Defaults to the two corner labels joined as "Before and After comparison".

props.name: handleValueText
props.description: Spoken value of the divider handle, given its whole-percent position. Defaults to the percentage followed by the before label in lower case.

props.name: position
props.description: Divider position as a percentage from the left (controlled)

props.name: defaultPosition
props.description: Initial divider position for uncontrolled use

props.name: onPositionChange
props.description: Convenience callback receiving the divider position on every change

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: CSS aspect-ratio of the frame (both images are sized to cover it)
